M01_completeness.desc: share of chunks with all 10 required fields non-empty

M02_schema_validity.desc: share of chunks valid against schema/chunk.schema.json

M03_open_conflicts.desc: detected conflicts without a recorded resolution

M04_active_logical_violations.desc: active graph edges violating a rule (minTestingAge)

M05_provenance_fidelity.desc: share of chunks whose source span (start:end) is contained in the chunk text

M06_expert_sample_accuracy.desc: share of expert-reviewed records with meta_ok and text_ok (36-record sample, LLM expert)

M07_conflict_documentation.desc: share of detected conflicts that have a decision-log entry and (value/temporal) a claim in the register

M08_near_duplicate_share.desc: share of chunks that the dedup rule would absorb (exact text, score>=th+band or judged DUP)

M09_freshness.desc: share of chunks with an ISO date not older than 365 days (relative to 2026-11-06)

M10_id_uniqueness.desc: share of chunk_id values that are unique

M11_graph_referential_integrity.desc: share of graph relationships whose both endpoints exist as nodes

M12_sensitivity_valid.desc: share of chunks with sensitivity in {public, internal, restricted}

M13_language_consistency.desc: share of chunks whose lang label agrees with the script of the text (Cyrillic share >0.3 <=> uk)

M14_self_retrieval_at1.desc: share of chunks retrieved as top-1 by a TF-IDF query built from their own middle 200 characters (absorbed chunks count via their canonical)
